visualCharacteristics.purpose: Accordion of full-width rows separated by thin rules; optionally shows the open item's image beside the list
visualCharacteristics.layout: Rows with a 20px title and a 16px chevron, 1px #dce2e5 rule between rows; rich-text answers 18/28. When items carry images: list and a square rounded image side by side from 900px, bar bullets.

contentPattern.description: FAQ question rows with rich-text answers; or items with title, description, bulleted list and an image.
contentPattern.structure: One row per item: cell 1 title (question); cell 2 content (paragraphs, lists, links, optional image).
contentPattern.notes: Without images all items start closed and several can be open. With images the first item opens by default and one item is open at a time; the image of the open item shows beside the list from 900px and inside the item on small screens.

usage.description: FAQ and expandable item lists, with an optional image per item.

reuseGuidance: Use for authored Q&A and expandable lists. Use faq for index-driven FAQ content and tabs for tabbed panels.
